---
title: "Short Vegetation + Hierarchy"
format:
  html:
    theme: journal
params:
  plot_number: "00000"
  plot_numbers: ""
  site_unit: ""
  project_id: ""
  apply_lumping: false
  display_value: "standard"
  report_title: "Short Vegetation + Hierarchy"
  project_root: ""
  db_path: "../data/vpro.duckdb"
  parquet_dir: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(duckdb)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(knitr.table.format = "html")
project_root <- params$project_root
db_root <- ""
db_path <- params$db_path
if (!is.null(db_path) && nzchar(trimws(db_path))) {
  db_candidate <- tryCatch(normalizePath(db_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) "")
  if (nzchar(db_candidate)) {
    db_root <- dirname(dirname(db_candidate))
  }
}
root_candidates <- c(
  if (!is.null(project_root)) project_root else "",
  db_root,
  Sys.getenv("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", unset = ""),
  getwd(),
  file.path(getwd(), ".."),
  file.path(getwd(), "../..")
)
root_candidates <- unique(root_candidates[nzchar(root_candidates)])
root_dir <- NA_character_
for (candidate in root_candidates) {
  candidate <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))) {
    root_dir <- candidate
    break
  }
}
if (is.na(root_dir)) stop("Unable to locate project root for report helpers.")
source(file.path(root_dir, "R", "logic_reports_veg.R"))
parquet_dir <- params$parquet_dir
if (!is.null(parquet_dir) && nzchar(trimws(parquet_dir))) {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = ":memory:")
  tbls <- c("vw_USysAllVeg")
  for (tbl in tbls) {
    file_name <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tbl), ".parquet")
    file_path <- file.path(parquet_dir, file_name)
    if (file.exists(file_path)) {
      dbExecute(
        con,
        sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS SELECT * FROM read_parquet('%s')", tbl, gsub("'", "''", file_path))
      )
    }
  }
} else {
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), params$db_path, read_only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
plots <- parse_plot_numbers(params$plot_number, params$plot_numbers)
if (length(plots) == 0 && (nzchar(trimws(params$site_unit)) || nzchar(trimws(params$project_id)))) {
  seed <- load_veg_report_data(
    con,
    plot_numbers = plots,
    site_unit = trimws(params$site_unit),
    project_id = trimws(params$project_id),
    apply_lumping = FALSE
  )
  plots <- unique(seed$plotnumber)
}
if (length(plots) > 0) {
  plot_sql <- paste(DBI::dbQuoteString(con, plots), collapse = ", ")
  veg <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sprintf("SELECT * FROM vw_USysAllVeg WHERE PlotNumber IN (%s)", plot_sql))
} else {
  veg <- data.frame()
}

normalize_veg_cols <- function(df) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(df)
  cols <- names(df)
  pick_col <- function(candidates) {
    idx <- which(tolower(cols) %in% tolower(candidates))
    if (length(idx) > 0) cols[[idx[1]]] else NA_character_
  }
  plot_col <- pick_col(c("plotnumber", "PlotNumber"))
  layer_col <- pick_col(c("mylayer", "layer", "MyLayer"))
  species_col <- pick_col(c("species", "species_code", "Species"))
  cover_col <- pick_col(c("covervalue", "cover_value", "cover", "CoverValue"))
  if (!is.na(plot_col)) df$PlotNumber <- df[[plot_col]]
  if (!is.na(layer_col)) df$MyLayer <- df[[layer_col]]
  if (!is.na(species_col)) df$Species <- df[[species_col]]
  if (!is.na(cover_col)) df$CoverValue <- df[[cover_col]]
  df
}

veg <- normalize_veg_cols(veg)

dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

hier_col <- NULL
for (candidate in c("Hierarchy", "HierarchyName", "hierarchy", "Hierarchy_Path", "HierarchyPath")) {
  if (candidate %in% names(veg)) {
    hier_col <- candidate
    break
  }
}
```

# `r params$report_title`

# Plot: `r params$plot_number`

```{r veg-table, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (nrow(veg) > 0) {
  desired <- c("PlotNumber", "MyLayer", "Species", "CoverValue")
  cols <- intersect(desired, names(veg))
  if (!is.null(hier_col)) cols <- c(cols, hier_col)
  view <- veg[, cols, drop = FALSE]

  if (!is.null(hier_col)) {
    view <- view[order(view[[hier_col]], view$Species), , drop = FALSE]
    split_view <- split(view, view[[hier_col]], drop = TRUE)
    view <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(split_view), function(name) {
      section <- split_view[[name]]
      header <- section[1, , drop = FALSE]
      header[] <- ""
      header[[hier_col]] <- paste0("Hierarchy: ", name)
      rbind(header, section)
    }))
  }

  kbl(view, align = "l") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No vegetation data found.")
}
```
